jobs.title: Growth Product Manager - Website & Conversion
jobs.description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Growth Product Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • Contentsquare

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager – Managed Detection and Incident Response (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally having secured our Series C funding of €60 Million!

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

About this role

As our client base continues to grow rapidly across Europe, this role will play a key strategic part in scaling our Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR) capabilities.

You'll take full ownership of the product strategy and roadmap for this space. Collaborating with our engineers, product designers, security operations, product marketing, and cross-functional leadership, you will ensure that our platform evolves with our customers' needs and delivers maximum impact at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor and thought leadership role designed for someone who thrives on autonomy, discovery, and leading cross-functional product development in a fast-growing environment. You'll be the strategic voice shaping our product direction, mentoring product managers, and influencing broader company strategy.

What you will do

  • Own and communicate the long-term product vision and strategy for MDR, EDR, and IR. Define strategic priorities, influence company OKRs, and drive cross-functional alignment around product direction.

  • Define and own the product roadmap for MDR, EDR, and IR, ensuring alignment with company vision, market opportunity, and customer needs.

  • Drive discovery practices to deeply understand customer needs, problems, and pain points.

  • Lead and mentor product managers and junior team members. Work closely with Engineering, Product Design, Security Operations, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales to deliver successful outcomes and build high-performing teams.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to define comprehensive go-to-market strategies, product launches, and market positioning that drive competitive advantage.

  • Manage external relationships and partnerships, especially with EDR vendors and MDR technology providers, ensuring alignment with our MSP and partner strategy.

  • Stay at the forefront of cybersecurity trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our internal processes, tooling, and product culture. Champion agile methodologies, data-driven execution, and continuous experimentation.

What you will need

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 4 years in senior or staff-level roles owning end-to-end delivery of software products in B2B SaaS or similar environments.

  • Deep cybersecurity domain expertise.

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software products in fast-paced environments using product discovery, data-driven decision making, and agile methodologies.

  • Strong business acumen: understanding of go-to-market strategy, sales enablement, and how product drives revenue and customer success.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex strategies clearly to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with comfort in ambiguity and the ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information.

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Startup or scale-up background at a high-growth company.

  • Experience building or scaling product management teams and processes.

  • Exposure to OKR-driven product development and metrics-focused product management.

  • Experience working with MSP or partner-led go-to-market models.

  • Track record of navigating successful product pivots or strategic repositioning.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • Full strategic ownership of a mission-critical product area in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

  • Mentorship and growth: lead and develop the next generation of product managers; grow into broader strategy and leadership roles.

  • Weekly lunches (NL) and Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including equity participation.

Are you up for it?

We look forward to receiving your application.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview for this role, please inform the TA team.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem is at a critical inflection point. As we scale our range of unique products, we need delivery that is predictable, transparent and built to scale.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager within our TPM team, you will drive the delivery of complex, high-stakes programs that bring our products from development to market. You will work across Hardware, Software and Science/AI, aligning teams around shared goals and turning technical complexity into clear plans and decisions.

This is a high-impact role that blends technical depth, delivery architecture and informal leadership. You will work in a complex, fast-scaling environment, and you will also help strengthen how the wider TPM team works.

Your Day-to-Day

Own the Execution Plan:

  • Architect and design end-to-end delivery plans for your team(s), from initial discovery or design phase until commercial launch.

  • Lead quarterly OKR planning and ensure it is fully aligned to company OKRs.

Lead Cross-Functional Coordination:

  • Co-lead product delivery with the Product Manager and Tech Leads. You own the how and when.

  • Manage dependencies across teams and relevant domains (technical, operations, business development), and keep stakeholders, including external partners, aligned.

Drive Risk & Decision-Making

  • Proactively identify, track, and mitigate technical and non-technical risks — timeline, resources, budget, and scope.

  • Escalate and resolve cross-team conflicts; create the decision-making frameworks other teams rely on.

Shape Ways of Working

  • Champion tooling and process best practices within the team and contribute workflows optimization within the TPM team. (e.g. refine the Product Development Lifecycle, Risk Management processes).

  • Coach and mentor other TPMs.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Program Leadership: Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional technical programs — ideally spanning hardware, software, and/or AI — with high delivery accountability.

  • Technical Depth: Solid understanding of how complex deep-tech products are engineered across Hardware, Software and Science/AI. You can evaluate trade-offs across all three domains well enough to challenge and guide engineering decisions. A technical background in systems engineering, MRI or AI/ML is a plus.

    • Practical understanding of how products are operated at customer sites, from early MVPs to mature deployments.

  • Execution & Planning: Expert in building and managing master program plans, sprint structures, milestone tracking, and risk registers across multiple concurrent workstreams.

    Stakeholder Management: Able to translate technical complexity into executive-level clarity and to influence and align without formal authority across matrixed organizations.

  • Change Management: Proven ability to drive adoption of new tools, frameworks, and processes (e.g. PDLC/PLM rollouts, agile tooling) across cross-functional teams — balancing structured change with the pace of a fast-moving scale-up.

  • Tooling & Process: Advanced setup of planning and tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence, covering portfolio dashboards, cross-team dependency and risk tracking, and executive-ready reporting. Hands-on with agentic AI tools that boost team efficiency.

  • Leadership & Culture: You are a servant leader who thrives in fast-growing scale-up environments, models candid communication, and creates psychological safety in high-stakes settings

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience with deep-tech products involving AI or MRI — or direct exposure to the Food & Fresh Produce industry, particularly melons or soft fruits — is a significant plus. Familiarity with industrializing sensor-based inspection systems for high-throughput agricultural or food processing environments is highly valued.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

jobs.title: AI Product Manager Intern - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As an AI Product Manager Intern at Reonic, you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and our customers.

You’ll help make sure new features are tested thoroughly, releases run smoothly, and customer feedback continuously makes its way back into the product development process.

This is not a coffee-run internship: you’ll take on real ownership from day one and work closely with engineers and other teams to improve both our product and the way we build and release it.

Please note: This is a fully onsite internship in Augsburg for 4–6 months.

What you’ll do

  • Support release testing: Help coordinate testing for upcoming releases and continuously test new features during development. Identify issues early and give clear, actionable feedback to engineering.

  • Help coordinate software releases: Keep track of features, changes, dependencies, and release timelines. Act as a communication hub between product, engineering, and other teams.

  • Improve product quality: Look beyond whether a feature technically works. Think about edge cases, usability, customer workflows, and how changes affect the overall product experience.

  • Turn feedback into action: Triage user feedback and bug reports, investigate and reproduce issues, and translate your findings into clear, well-described tickets for engineering.

  • Communicate what’s new: Write release notes, help run internal demos, and make sure colleagues understand what has changed and how new functionality works.

  • Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the development process, ask the right questions, and help remove ambiguity before features reach customers.

  • Understand our customers: Build a deep understanding of the businesses using Reonic and use that context to contribute to better product decisions.


What makes you a great fit

  • Product mindset: You naturally think beyond checklists. You want to understand why something is being built, who it is for, and what makes it useful.

  • Attention to detail: You spot inconsistencies, edge cases, and potential issues before they become customer problems.

  • Strong communication: You communicate clearly with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders. Professional fluency in English (C1+) is required.

  • Technical curiosity: You enjoy understanding how software works and aren’t afraid to dig into technical details, investigate bugs, or learn new concepts.

  • Hands-on with AI tools: Coding isn’t required, but you’ve already vibe-coded a thing or two. You can quickly build a rough prototype to show engineers how a more complex feature could work, so they get a clear picture before the real build starts.

  • Customer orientation: You care about the experience of the people using the product and can turn qualitative feedback into actionable insights.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility, follow things through, and don’t wait for someone else to solve a problem you can help solve yourself.

  • Startup mindset: You’re comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and processes are still being built.

  • Student status: You’re currently enrolled at a university and available full-time for 4–6 months. A background in economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field is helpful, but not required.

  • Nice to have: First experience through internships, working student jobs, or university projects in product management, product operations, QA, software development, or B2B SaaS.


Why join us?

  • Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

  • A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, so your work will reach real users.

  • Learn fast: Get hands-on experience in product management at a fast-growing startup, with close mentorship from our product and engineering team.

  • High ownership: Nothing is set in stone. You’ll have room to shape how we work and how the product evolves, even as an intern.

  • A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

  • Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

  • Fair compensation: We offer a competitive internship salary.

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn’t hold you back. We value talent and passion above all.


About Reonic
At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.
Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses, from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.
Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast.


Location & duration
This is a full-time, on-site internship based in Augsburg for 4–6 months.


Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Product Manager - Operations
jobs.description:
About our team:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our product team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

Job Summary:

As a Senior Product Manager - Operations, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Radiant’s internal tooling and integrations, helping teams operate and scale the cloud platform efficiently.

You’ll work across CMDB, asset and service inventory, internal APIs, workflow automation, third-party integrations, and platform administration, partnering closely with engineering, SRE, infrastructure, networking, security, and operations.

This is a highly technical product role focused on reducing operational friction, improving self-service, and creating reliable, scalable internal systems.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of internal tooling, CMDB, service catalogues, operational workflows, and integrations.

  • Translate business and operational needs into clear product requirements, specs, user stories, data models, and priorities.

  • Partner with engineering to define solutions across APIs, integrations, automation, and platform tooling.

  • Work with SRE, infrastructure, security, support, and other internal users to identify pain points and improve automation and self-service.

  • Establish reliable sources of truth for infrastructure, services, customers, environments, ownership, and configuration.

  • Drive prioritisation, backlog management, technical design discussions, delivery, and adoption.

  • Define success metrics and ensure tooling is secure, observable, auditable, reliable, and well documented.

  • Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and third-party tooling where appropriate.

Qualifications:

  • Experience owning technical products, internal platforms, developer tooling, or infrastructure products end-to-end.

  • Experience working across data centre operations, hardware lifecycle and inventory, infrastructure support, field operations, or adjacent operational environments.

  • Strong technical fluency across:

    • APIs & integrations: REST, gRPC, webhooks, third-party APIs

    • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, cloud platforms, containers, infrastructure-as-code

    • Data & CMDB: relational modelling, inventory, ownership, dependency mapping

    • Automation: queues, schedulers, workflow engines, event-driven systems

    • Observability & security: logging, metrics, tracing, IAM, RBAC, audit logging

jobs.description:
What We're Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.

Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

What You'll Build

  • Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

  • Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

  • Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

  • Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

  • Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

  • Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

  • Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

  • Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

  • Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production

  • Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers

  • Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically

  • Experience with project budgets and risk tracking

  • Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership

  • A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow

  • Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners

  • Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership

Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.

Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.

Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Benefits & Growth

  • Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners

  • Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase

  • Annual learning budget to invest in your growth, from conferences to deep dives into new domains

  • Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day

jobs.description:

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.

  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

jobs.title: Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan.

The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base.

As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers.

To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance, Legal and Ops leaders.

We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team.

From the day you join until we are fully licensed, you will structure and execute the legal path to authorization: interpret requirements, translate them into an internal plan, and ensure deliverables are complete, consistent, and aligned across teams. You will help define the target operating model (intra-group and outsourced) and ensure it is legally defensible and well documented for the application.

After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk).

This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, and the opportunity to shape the legal culture of a fast-growing fintech while managing and mentoring an experienced Legal Counsel, with the ambition to scale the team further as the business grows.

Organisation & Reporting

You will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel.

You will manage a seasoned Legal Counsel and will be responsible for planning the future growth of the Financial Services Legal team. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team.

Mission & Objectives

Team Leadership & Structuring

  • You manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture.

  • You structure the team’s workload and roadmap, delegating effectively while remaining deeply hands-on.

  • You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team.

Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized.

Products, contracts and customer legal architecture

  • You own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable).

  • You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications).

Outsourcing / BaaS transition & vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny.

Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).

Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers.

Regulatory engagement support & internal enablement

  • Until we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&A packs, position papers, meeting preparation).

  • Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc.

  • You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services.

Culture, Training & Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes.

About you

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS.

  • You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment.

  • You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes.

  • Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar).

  • Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc).

Skills & mindset

Technical strengths You can credibly lead on :

  • ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing;

  • Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments;

  • Governance and regulated-entity corporate law basics.

Soft skills

  • Player-coach mentality: capable of executing complex individual contributions while guiding and empowering your team.

  • You can work fast without losing rigour.

  • Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex regulatory legal topics to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms.

  • Pragmatic, impact-driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation.

  • Very strong written and oral communication skills in both French and English.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Stanislas (1h), Head of Legal, Risk & Compliance

3. Case Study with Stanislas & Maxime (1h)

4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

You’ll combine strategic product ownership with a hands-on, data-driven approach to solve emerging issues while building systems and tools that improve detection precision.

  • Integrate A/B testing and iterative validation to refine detection models and user intervention flows.

  • Stay informed on global fraud trends in mobile gaming and ad revenue-based platforms to keep our defenses innovative and effective.

  • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in digital products with complex user behavior and ad-driven monetisation models.

  • Strong experience in AdTech or ad monetisation, such as attribution, measurement platforms, or ad networks.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using behavioral data, patterns, and signals to improve product decisions.

  • Proficient in designing and measuring the impact of A/B tests in risk and fraud scenarios.

  • Skilled at cross-functional collaboration with engineers, analysts, and operations to drive implementation of scalable fraud solutions.

  • Excellent problem-solving mindset, analytical orientation, and strong communication skills.

  • Nice to have: Experience with behavioral fraud, KYC/identity verification, Trust & Safety, risk management, or fraud prevention.

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fisheries / IUUF
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing.

Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence.

The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.




Key Responsibilities
  • Own the Fisheries product strategy, vision, and roadmap, defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market.
  • Lead the development and delivery of the first Fisheries product release, focused on live fleet monitoring and subsequently catch and yield reporting that procurement and compliance teams can rely on.
  • Lead market and customer discovery with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction.
  • Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience, ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for customers across the seafood supply chain.
  • Establish the vessel identity, dark-behaviour, and catch-estimation methodologies underpinning the product, working with data and domain experts to ensure the outputs are credible, transparent, and trusted.
  • Own positioning and competitive strategy, monitoring the existing commercial and NGO-adjacent landscape and clearly defining Kpler's differentiation.
  • Lead the go-to-market strategy for the product, working with Sales and Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and early customer adoption.
  • Identify and develop strategic partnerships across the seafood supply chain, including data, certification, and distribution partnerships that can strengthen the product and accelerate adoption.
  • Act as the key link between Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, creating alignment around product strategy, priorities, launch plans, and customer outcomes.
  • Track product performance, customer feedback, delivery progress, and key risks, using evidence and market insight to continuously refine the roadmap and maximise product impact.

    • Skills and Responsibilities
  • 5–7 years of Product Management or senior commercial experience, ideally within maritime data, seafood supply chains, or a related B2B data/SaaS environment.
  • Proven track record of owning products end-to-end, from strategy and customer discovery through to delivery, launch, and customer adoption.
  • Strong track record of translating complex customer needs into clear product strategy, roadmap priorities, and product requirements, working closely with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of the fisheries data landscape, including vessel tracking, IUU risk, catch documentation, and supply chain traceability.
  • Experience operating in ambiguous, early-stage environments, with a pragmatic and iterative approach to building, launching, learning, and improving products.
  • Strong commercial and go-to-market experience, including product positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and working closely with Sales and Marketing.
  • Strong data and analytical literacy, with the ability to work effectively with data and engineering teams and understand maritime and trade data concepts such as AIS, vessel identity, geospatial analysis, ownership, and flows.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical, commercial, regulatory, and NGO audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior external stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership mindset and a bias to action, with the confidence to make decisions, navigate uncertainty, and focus on delivering outcomes rather than perfection.

    • Nice to have
  • Direct experience within the fisheries or seafood sector, particularly procurement, traceability, or certification.
  • Experience building and launching a new product line rather than managing an established product.
  • An established network across seafood buyers, certification bodies, regulators, or fisheries NGOs.
  • Understanding of relevant fisheries regulations, including IUU regulations, US SIMP, or the EU carding system.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Chez Theodo GovTech, nous accompagnons nos clients - ministères, collectivités territoriales et grands opérateurs publics - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société.
Rejoindre notre aventure, c'est partager une ambition commune : utiliser le numérique pour augmenter l’efficacité de l'action publique et améliorer le quotidien des agents et des usagers.

Tes futures missions :
En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client.
 
- Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client.
- Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…).
- Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème.
- Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints.
- Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions.
- Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks.
- Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives).
 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
- France Identité : Dans le cadre du lancement de la carte grise numérique sur France Identité, wallet souverain piloté par l’ANTS et aligné avec eIDAS 2, Theodo a repris le développement mobile (iOS & Android) en natif dans un contexte de retards et de standards européens mouvants. Une équipe de 9 experts a structuré la delivery en sprints de 3 semaines et sécurisé les mises en production. Résultats en 2 mois : +350 000 cartes grises dématérialisées, +20 % de qualité technique et une cadence de livraison continue restaurée.
 
- Ministère de l'Intérieur : Dans le cadre de la LOPMI et de la feuille de route interministérielle sur l’IA, le Ministère de l’Intérieur a lancé MIrAI pour industrialiser des produits d’IA utiles aux agents (transcription, rédaction, automatisation). Theodo a accompagné la structuration de l’organisation produit (vision, discovery, delivery) et la mise en production de FCR, outil d’aide à la génération automatique de comptes rendus. Une équipe de 7 experts (Lead PM, PO, Designer, Tech Lead, 3 Software Engineers) a posé les bases d’une véritable usine produit IA au sein de l’État, capable d’identifier, livrer et industrialiser rapidement de nouveaux cas d’usage.
 
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
 
Profil recherché :
- Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client.
- Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet.
- Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance.
- Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins.
- Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo GovTech ?
L’environnement:
💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités
🤝  Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires.
🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…)
🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel
 
Le package :
📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe
💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo
🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…)
🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...)
