jobs.title: Softwaretester / QA Engineer als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Mach aus guten Ideen Software, die im Alltag überzeugt

Du probierst neue Funktionen aus und merkst schnell, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft? Du willst Fehler verstehen, Lösungen mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team ein Produkt besser machen? Dann könnte das deine Rolle bei AUGLETICS sein.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren smarte Rudergeräte in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Bei uns siehst du direkt, wie deine Arbeit das Training unserer Kunden verbessert: Du testest am echten Gerät, arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung zusammen und begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Release.

Du ergänzt unser Softwareteam mit vier bis fünf Personen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Dein Schwerpunkt ist Softwarequalität. Dazu übernimmst du technische Projektkoordination: Du bringst Ordnung in offene Aufgaben, klärst Anforderungen und hilfst dem Team, Ideen zuverlässig umzusetzen. In diese Verantwortung kannst du hineinwachsen.

Das machst du bei uns

  • App und Gerät gründlich testen: Du prüfst neue Funktionen, typische Trainingsabläufe und Grenzfälle und gibst konkretes Feedback zu Funktion und Bedienbarkeit.

  • Tests aufbauen und verbessern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, Checklisten und wiederholbare Regressionstests. Schritt für Schritt baust du Testautomatisierung auf – immer dort, wo sie dem Produkt und dem Team hilft.

  • Fehler bis zur Lösung verfolgen: Du beschreibst reproduzierbare Schritte, grenzt Ursachen gemeinsam mit der Entwicklung ein und prüfst, ob eine Korrektur auch im Zusammenspiel mit anderen Funktionen funktioniert.

  • Projekte ins Ziel bringen: Du strukturierst Aufgaben, formulierst klare Abnahmekriterien, koordinierst Abhängigkeiten und machst Fortschritt und offene Fragen sichtbar.

  • Zusammenarbeit erleichtern: Du moderierst agile Abstimmungen, etwa aus Scrum oder Kanban, und hilfst, Hindernisse zu beseitigen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team entwickelst du Abläufe weiter, die zu uns passen.

  • KI praktisch nutzen: Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge für Testideen, Fehleranalyse, kleine Hilfsprogramme und Automatisierung ein und überprüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Interesse an Softwaretests, Qualitätssicherung und technischen Projekten. Erste Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung – auch ein eigener Lernweg oder die Motivation, dich neu in das Thema einzuarbeiten, interessieren uns.

  • Freude daran, genau hinzuschauen und Probleme systematisch zu lösen. Du kannst verständlich erklären, was nicht funktioniert und wie es sich nachstellen lässt.

  • Technisches Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von App, Gerät und Backend sowie Lust, dich tiefer einzuarbeiten.

  • Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Du fragst nach, hältst offene Punkte nach und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte Entwicklung und Tests. Wenn du damit schon selbst experimentiert hast, zeig uns gern ein Beispiel.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich, um technische Themen im Team sicher zu besprechen und zu dokumentieren. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort in Königs Wusterhausen zu arbeiten: Viele Tests finden direkt am Rudergerät statt.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Android-Entwicklung, zum Beispiel mit Kotlin oder Java.

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps und dem Zusammenspiel von App, Benutzerkonten und gespeicherten Daten.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Erste Kenntnisse in Testautomatisierung, Git, CI/CD oder agiler Projektarbeit. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist nicht erforderlich.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du anfassen und ausprobieren kannst, und viele Ideen, die wir gemeinsam in hoher Qualität umsetzen wollen.

  • Ein Team von rund 25 Mitarbeitenden, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde.

  • Raum, fachlich zu wachsen und zunehmend Verantwortung für Qualität, Tests und Projektabläufe zu übernehmen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein Beispielprojekt oder ein Testkonzept ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. The role focuses on hands-on software testing and quality assurance, with growing responsibility for project coordination. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

jobs.title: Product Manager Digital Platforms
jobs.description:
🌊 Who are we?


We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

AURA is the platform Aquablu runs on. It replaced about 15 tools with one system of record, gives every colleague their own AI agent, and connects to hundreds of our systems in the field. Version 2.0 just went live. What it becomes next is your call.

You own AURA’s direction: what gets built, why, and in what order. Then you build it yourself. You’ll write features with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and deploy them to production. Our engineering team sets the architecture, reviews your work, and makes sure the platform stays safe while you move fast.

You don’t need to have been an engineer. You do need to want to ship code. You’ll report to our Head of Digital Product.


What you'll Do

  • Own the roadmap: prioritize by business value and user pain. Kill ideas that don’t earn their place.

  • Find the real problem: work directly with the teams who use AURA every day.

  • Build features yourself: go from idea to working feature with AI, not to a spec handed off to someone else.

  • Deploy to production: ship your own features, with engineers reviewing and guiding your work.

  • Keep leadership aligned: explain your priorities and trade-offs from decision to launch.

  • Measure and iterate: define success for every feature, check whether it landed, and go again.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?

AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.


Why a designer now

We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.

That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.

You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.

Journeys and engagement

  • Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.

  • Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.

  • Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.

Growth surfaces

  • Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.

  • Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.

Craft and UI ownership

  • You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.

  • During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.

Design system and enablement

  • Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.

  • Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.

How you work

  • You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.

  • You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.

  • You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.

On a typical week

On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. 

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience.

On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.

In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.

On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined.


We offer

  • A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution;

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;

  • Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;

  • Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here 

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 5 Mental health days per year;

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. 


Who you are

You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if:

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech.

  • You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around  you. 

  • You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas.

  • You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion.

  • You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence.

  • You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard.

  • You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same.

  • You see feedback as a way to improve the work, hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so.

  • You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week.

You will work closely with Account Managers, Sales, Product Owners, Engineering and Delivery teams to connect customer expectations with our Product strategy, identify opportunities shared across multiple customers, and provide clear visibility on Product scope, dependencies and roadmap maturity.

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager
jobs.description:
Enterprise Product Manager

The Role

Lyrebird is already trusted by thousands of clinicians, and the largest health organisations in Australia and the UK are now rolling it out across their entire workforce. This is a new role, created to lead the next chapter of our enterprise product as those deployments grow in size and ambition. You'll own the enterprise product end to end: the core platform capability that serves every enterprise customer, and the tailored work that deepens our partnership with specific ones. You'll have a real roadmap, a real engineering team, and the scope to shape where enterprise goes next.

A good week in this role might include a roadmap session with a state health service's IT team, a deep dive with a private hospital group to understand what's behind their latest request and how it could become something every enterprise customer benefits from, and a morning with engineering working out which of three competing priorities goes first. Your customers are the people deploying Lyrebird across their organisation, not the clinicians themselves, so you'll spend more time in customer conversations than most PMs do. If you enjoy that mix, and like being the person who makes the call when everything seems urgent, you'll do well here.

About Us

We turn real clinical conversations into accurate notes, automatically, backed by ambient real time document creation, intelligent document management and clinical workflow automation, native patient data integrations across siloed health systems, and a patient and clinical communications layer. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We're growing fast across Melbourne, the UK, and Asia, and there's a finite window right now to set the standard for clinical AI in Australia before anyone else does.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise product, extending how Lyrebird serves hospitals, health services and multi-site groups: org hierarchy, SSO and provisioning, admin tooling, template governance, audit and usage reporting

  • Shape the enterprise roadmap, sequencing the platform capability that unlocks our next wave of large-scale deployments, and use it as a tool to communicate direction to customers, setting clear expectations about what's coming and when.

  • Build and own the prioritisation framework for enterprise, with clear, written criteria for core and tailored work that the whole business can rely on

  • Bring several independent streams of enterprise requests into one set of priorities, so every request has a clear home, a priority and a rationale anyone can explain

  • Turn tailored customer requests into buildable solutions, and spot the ones that are really core product needs wearing a customer's name

  • Stand up the voice-of-customer loop, spending real time with senior customer stakeholders and making sure what they tell you shapes what gets built

  • Drive roadmap decisions from usage and adoption data, working hand in hand with our UK team so every market benefits from what we learn

  • Deliver customer-specific integrations and workflows for some of the largest health organisations in the country, coordinating across engineering teams you don't own

What you'll bring

  • Experience owning a B2B or enterprise product end to end, shipped for large, complex organisations with their own governance, stakeholders and procurement

  • A track record of handling bespoke customer work without refusing it outright or letting it consume the roadmap, and the real examples to show how you made those calls

  • A habit of prioritising with written, defensible criteria, and the ability to walk through the trade-offs behind decisions you've made

  • Credibility in the room with senior enterprise customers: presenting and defending a roadmap to an executive or IT lead, and knowing when to hold the line and when to change course

  • The technical fluency to work credibly with engineers on architecture, integration and feasibility, and to land dependencies with teams that have their own roadmaps

Nice to have

  • Experience in health tech, clinical software or another regulated domain, including familiarity with EMRs and Australian health system structures such as LHDs, HHSs and private hospital groups

  • Hands-on experience building enterprise platform capability (SSO, provisioning, permissions, audit) or integration depth with HL7, FHIR and identity

  • An understanding of what hospital security, privacy and information-governance reviews demand of a vendor

  • Experience working across two markets with different regulatory requirements, or standing up a voice-of-customer loop from scratch

When a hospital rolls Lyrebird out to every clinician on every ward, the product has to work for the organisation as well as for the doctor in the room. The enterprise product is how thousands more clinicians spend their time on patients instead of paperwork, in the places where the pressure, and the risk of something being missed, is highest. That's the work.

We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you're from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement.

Piloter le produit de bout en bout :

jobs.title: Android-Entwickler als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Entwickle Android-Software, die Menschen in Bewegung bringt

Du möchtest Android-Apps entwickeln und sehen, wie dein Code in einem echten Produkt zum Einsatz kommt? Bei AUGLETICS entwickelst du Software für smarte Rudergeräte und unsere App. Du kannst neue Funktionen direkt ausprobieren und gemeinsam mit dem Team verbessern – vom ersten Prototyp bis zur zuverlässigen Anwendung.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Unser Unternehmen hat rund 25 Mitarbeitende; im Softwareteam arbeitest du mit vier bis fünf Personen und direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Wir haben viele Ideen und suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, gerne programmiert und Wert auf gute Ergebnisse legt.

Das entwickelst du bei uns

  • Android-Funktionen für Gerät und App: Du entwickelst neue Features, verbesserst bestehende Abläufe und arbeitest an einer verständlichen, zuverlässigen Bedienung.

  • Das Zusammenspiel im Blick: Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zwischen App, Gerätesoftware und Backend und hilfst, Datenflüsse und Fehlerfälle sauber zu lösen.

  • Ideen praktisch erproben: Du setzt Prototypen um, probierst sie am Rudergerät aus und entwickelst gute Ansätze mit dem Team weiter.

  • Qualität von Anfang an: Du schreibst nachvollziehbaren Code, beteiligst dich an Reviews und Tests und behebst Fehler nachhaltig.

  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge für Ideen, Code, Tests und Fehleranalyse. Du verstehst und prüfst die Ergebnisse, bevor sie ins Produkt gelangen.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Programmiergrundlagen und Lust auf native Android-Entwicklung mit Kotlin oder Java. Praktische Android-Erfahrung ist willkommen; wenn du dich neu in Android einarbeitest, interessieren uns dein bisheriger Lernweg und deine Motivation.

  • Du kannst erklären, wie du technische Aufgaben angehst. Eigene Apps, Lernprojekte, Hochschulprojekte, Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen genauso wie berufliche Erfahrung.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis von Programmiergrundlagen und Interesse daran, verständliche, wartbare und getestete Software zu entwickeln.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte App-Entwicklung. Wenn du solche Werkzeuge bereits ausprobiert hast, interessiert uns, was gut funktioniert hat und wie du die Ergebnisse geprüft hast.

  • Eigeninitiative, Freude an Zusammenarbeit und Lust, dich in ein bestehendes Produkt einzuarbeiten und schrittweise Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist für den technischen Austausch im Team erforderlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig in Königs Wusterhausen vor Ort zu arbeiten, um Funktionen am Gerät zu entwickeln und mit dem Team abzustimmen.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps, zum Beispiel bei Benutzeranmeldung, Datenspeicherung oder serverseitiger Logik.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Kenntnisse in Git, automatisierten Tests, CI/CD oder der Anbindung von APIs und Geräten.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du direkt ausprobieren kannst, und sichtbaren Einfluss auf das Training unserer Kunden.

  • Ein kleines Softwareteam, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde und kurze Wege zwischen Idee, Entwicklung und Test.

  • Raum für eigene Ideen und fachliche Entwicklung – mit Aufgaben, die zu deinem Erfahrungsstand passen und mit dir wachsen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein GitHub-Link oder eine App ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. You will develop Android software for our connected rowing machines and app, working closely with our CTO and a small team. Early-career developers with practical projects are welcome. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Tax and Recs (Europe)
jobs.description:
Hybrid role based in our London office (3 days a week)

 

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help build the next chapter of Seccl in Ireland and shape the future of investing across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

We’re looking for a Senior product manager to join the Tax and Recs squad in our European tribe. You’ll own how we reconcile client cash and assets, and how we help our clients report their customers’ tax correctly, as we grow across Europe.

Our European strategy has two parts. First, we’re going deep in Ireland, building a full proposition with the products, tax wrappers and pensions that Irish firms and their clients need. Second, we’re building the foundations to spread at speed into more European countries, with a focused offering for each market rather than a rebuild every time we enter a new one. The Tax and Recs squad makes both possible: we can only grow if our reconciliations hold up under regulatory scrutiny and our tax engine is something clients can trust.

You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. You’ll work closely with our Operations, Compliance and Customer teams, and with key European clients. A reliable tax engine is not just a regulatory necessity, it is a genuine advantage when we sell to new firms, so your work will be felt well beyond the squad.

What you’ll own

  • Scaling our cash and stock reconciliations to meet Client Asset Requirements (CAR) in Ireland, so we can grow volumes with confidence

  • Making sure our Operations team’s processes work in Europe and scale as we do

  • Building the tax reporting and tax engine for Ireland, so our clients can report tax correctly on behalf of their customers across the wrappers that matter to Irish firms

  • Localising that foundation to each wrapper and each country across Europe, rather than starting again every time

  • Connecting directly to tax authorities where a country requires us to pay tax on behalf of our clients’ customers

  • Making our tax engine reliable, transparent and easy to build on, so tax becomes a reason firms choose Seccl

  • Defining and prioritising the Tax and Recs squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with what the next European markets will need

  • Translating regulatory requirements, including CAR and Irish tax rules, into clear product requirements with Compliance

  • Breaking down complex problems like localising a tax engine into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

  • Using quantitative and qualitative data, such as break rates, exceptions and resolution times, to make evidence-based decisions

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in reconciliations, custody, investment operations or tax in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions, insurance)

  • You understand client money and money flow

  • You’re comfortable operating in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments where structure doesn’t yet exist

  • You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

  • You’re highly proactive: you create momentum rather than wait for direction

  • You’re customer-obsessed, with a focus on improving workflows and outcomes

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, working comfortably with Operations, Compliance, Customer and Engineering, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

 

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

 

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

 

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

 

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

 

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager + team member

  • Second stage – one-hour technical focused interview, we will share a case study task in advance for you to present back to us on

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

     

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

 

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

 

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

Compensation: £75K – £90K

You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. Working alongside a small, high-impact European team, our Compliance and Commercial colleagues and key European clients, you’ll play a central role in taking us from a deep Irish proposition to a scalable European one.

What you’ll own

  • Launching an Irish Personal Investment Account (PIA). This is a new tax-incentivised product that isn’t yet live in the market, which makes it a genuine first mover opportunity for Seccl and our clients. Moving quickly and getting it right will matter.

  • Introducing jurisdiction into the Seccl platform, so products, rules and regulation can vary by country without rebuilding it each time

  • Building the foundations that let us scale onboarding for firms, clients and accounts and expand at speed across Europe

  • Integrating a third-party pension provider, so Irish firms can offer their clients a fuller suite of products

  • Turning Irish and European regulatory requirements into clear product requirements, working closely with Compliance

  • Defining and prioritising the Account squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with the foundations Europe will need

  • Breaking down complex problems like jurisdiction into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

  • Adapting and extending UK product and engineering capabilities for European markets

  • Making trade-offs across speed, risk and customer value in a highly regulated environment

  • Using quantitative and qualitative data to make evidence-based decisions

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in account, onboarding or customer lifecycle products in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions or insurance)

  • You have launched regulated products into European markets and understand how requirements can differ from one country to the next

  • You have experience of integrating with third-party providers, platforms or APIs

  • You’re comfortable in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments, making trade-offs across speed, risk and customer value

  • You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

  • You’re highly proactive, creating momentum rather than waiting for direction

  • You’re customer-obsessed, focused on improving workflows and outcomes

  • You thrive in cross-functional teams, working with Compliance, Commercial and Engineering and communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Desirable: you’ve launched regulated products into European markets, or integrated with third-party providers, platforms or APIs

This role isn’t for you if:

  • You rely on top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership – it’s up to you to shape your growth and deliver outcomes.

  • You’re uncomfortable in a fast-paced environment. Our ability to move quickly and scale effectively is key to our success – we need people who can adapt and think on their feet.

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who not only think big, but also deliver.

  • You resist change. We’re growing quickly, and the environment can be ambiguous – you’ll thrive here if you see change as an opportunity rather than a hurdle. 

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager + team member

  • Second stage – one-hour technical focused interview, we will share a case study task in advance for you to present back to us on

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Chez Theodo HealthTech, l'entité experte en santé, nous accompagnons tous les acteurs de la santé dans le développement des dispositifs médicaux digitaux sur-mesure. Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients. 

Tes futures missions :
En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. Tu seras pour cela encadré par un Lead Product Manager.
 
- Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client.
- Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…).
- Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème.
- Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints.
- Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions.
- Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks.
- Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives).
 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
- Hub Santé : lancé par l’Agence du Numérique en Santé en 2024, vise à connecter en temps réel les 83 SAMU, SMUR, SDIS et autres acteurs de l’urgence, dans un écosystème historiquement fragmenté. Accompagnée par une équipe de 3 experts Theodo, l’ANS a déployé une plateforme nationale d’interopérabilité permettant une coordination critique plus fluide et sécurisée. Résultats : +10 SAMU connectés dès la phase pilote, interopérabilité effective sur plusieurs périmètres et conformité HDS maintenue.
 
- Vidal : référence centenaire de l’information médicale, a développé avec Theodo un assistant médical basé sur l’IA générative pour fournir aux professionnels de santé des réponses fiables en un temps record et sécuriser la prescription. En 8 semaines, une équipe de 4 experts Theodo a conçu un POC de chatbot RAG connecté à la base Vidal, capable de réduire le temps de recherche tout en garantissant traçabilité et fiabilité des sources. Objectif : renforcer la confiance des praticiens et faire entrer Vidal dans l’ère du service médical “fonctionnel”.
 
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
 
Profil recherché :
- Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, avec jusqu’à 2 ans d’expérience professionnelle, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client.
- Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet.

- Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins.
- Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo HealthTech ?
L’environnement:
💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités
🤝  Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires.

Staff Engineer
Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product

Our mission for you

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.


We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

Your team

You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.

Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.

Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

Who we are looking for

Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.

Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.

Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.

Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.

Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.

AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.

Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.


90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • You deeply understand trawa's business and product

  • You have established your philosophy of running Product & Tech teams’ delivery

  • You shape new quarterly roadmap and OKR plans for your teams

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • You have assembled the company around your product vision for the entire customer journey

  • Your vision for the customer journey comes to live - first key metrics are moved

  • Your teams follow your rhythm of value delivery in fast measurable iterations

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: This is a rare opportunity to own product end-to-end at a company where product is the business. You won't be managing a feature backlog — you'll be shaping a platform that spans energy trading, real-time asset steering, and enterprise software. Few product roles in Europe offer this combination of complexity, commercial impact, and speed.

Responsibility & Support: You'll join the leadership team with direct impact on company strategy. We support you through regular leadership sessions, cross-department leadership initiatives, and experienced mentors who want to see you succeed.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

jobs.title: Growth Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Zable is about to become the face of Lendable. We’re rebranding the company and product, significantly increasing our D2C marketing investment, and building out a marketing function under our newly appointed CMO. It’s one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, backed by real financial strength, a large customer base and a product people love.

Partnerships and sponsorships will be central to how we grow, and we’re building the team to make that happen. As our Growth Partnerships Manager, you’ll shape the strategy and the budget, not just manage the day-to-day. Reporting to the Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll define our commercial approach, decide where partnership spend goes, and take every deal from first conversation to live activation: agreeing terms, making sure campaigns land well, and keeping partners engaged. You’ll also make the case for each investment, with the data to back it, to senior leadership.

This is a senior seat for someone who enjoys both the creative and the analytical sides of partnerships. You’ll have real budget responsibility, model payback economics, and bring colleagues with you on the big calls. If you think about CPA, rev share and LTV:CAC as naturally as you think about relationships, you’ll feel at home here.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in partnerships, affiliate marketing, sponsorships, BD or growth roles for a consumer brand, including time spent shaping commercial strategy, not just executing it

  • Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics, CPA, Revenue share, LTV, ROI and blended CAC, and comfortable moving between them when structuring a deal

  • Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

  • Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

  • Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

  • Strong account / relationship management skills

  • Comfortable with the data, channel economics, attribution and ROI

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can run multiple activations in parallel

  • Strong commercial communicator, you can hold your own with senior partners and senior internal stakeholders alike

  • Experience setting and owning a partnerships budget or channel P&L, with the judgement to reprioritise spend as performance data comes in

  • Comfortable presenting strategy and performance to senior leadership, and defending investment decisions with data

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

  • Experience in fintech or financial services

  • Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

  • Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

  • Experience with affiliate, influencer or embedded finance partnerships

  • Some deal structuring experience

  • Experience line-managing or mentoring a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • A natural relationship-builder, partners trust you, and so does your team

  • A strategic thinker as much as a doer, you can zoom out to set the plan, then zoom back in to execute it yourself

  • Commercially literate first, relationship-led second, you measure success in growth, not vanity

  • A strong project manager, you keep things moving and on-budget

  • Data-fluent , you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

  • Hands-on and resourceful, you make things happen

  • Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

Leadership & Strategy:

  • Set the partnerships strategy and roadmap, and own the case for investment with senior leadership

  • Mentor and support a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

  • Represent the partnerships function in senior leadership and budget reviews

Commercial & Performance:

  • Negotiate commercial terms with affiliates, influencers and sponsorship partners – CPA, Revenue share, hybrid and flat-fee structures – and know which model fit the partner

  • Own the partnerships budget and unit economics of every live partnership: track CAC by channel and partner against LTV, and flag anything trending the wrong way before it becomes a budget problem

  • Build and maintain the channel-economics view that lets the team compare partnership spend against other acquisition channels

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Position:

Sonar is looking for an Inside Sales Executive to join a Major Accounts pod and support two Major Account Managers in covering a portfolio of key accounts end to end. You will help the pod reach complete coverage of each account by prospecting into entities that are not yet customers and supporting entities that already run Sonar instances. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Turn new revenue opportunities into products construction companies pay for.


Your mission

Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

We see several ways to grow from here, such as new modules for existing customers or customer segments we don't serve yet. As our Senior PM for Growth, you'll own one of these opportunities and you'll help choose the next. Next to that, you'll take care of the day-to-day product work in your area.

What you'll do

  • Find the real problem. Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build.

  • Put AI to work. Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love.

  • Test before you build. Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering.

  • Bring it to market. Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in.

After one year, you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue.

How we work

  • Full ownership. You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you.

  • Close to the customer. You'll talk to customers constantly.

  • Fast and data-driven. We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers.

  • AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands?

What you bring

  • 3–5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on

  • You've taken a new revenue opportunity (a module, upsell, segment or market) from idea to a product customers pay for

  • You've shipped AI features that customers actually use, and you use AI tools every day in your own work

  • You work with numbers and experiments, and you change course when the data says so

  • You explain complex things simply, to a site manager as well as to management

  • German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our engineering team in English

  • Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or with construction or another industry that is just going digital.

Why us?

  • Real impact: You own a growth opportunity, with short decision paths to our Head of Product, and you see the result in our numbers.

  • A head start: Your first opportunity is prepared for you, so you can get going from day one.

  • Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

  • Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Europe, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo AI-Modernization
jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
 
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred.
 
Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! 

Tes futures missions :
En tant que Lead Product Manager, tu pilotes des projets produits complexes en portant la vision produit, en orchestrant le delivery et en garantissant la création de valeur pour le client comme pour les équipes.
 
- Définir et porter la stratégie produit avec le client : modélisation de la valeur, architecture produit, EPICs, arbitrage des trade-offs et alignement technico-fonctionnel.
- Assurer un delivery réussi en coordonnant plusieurs squads pour livrer des projets complexes dans les temps, le budget et le niveau de qualité attendu.
- Créer les conditions de réussite des équipes en définissant le bon set-up (équipes Theodo ou partenaires), en négociant les moyens nécessaires et en adaptant l’organisation aux contraintes du projet.
- Apporter de la visibilité et de la clarté via des dispositifs de gouvernance adaptés, pour aligner l’ensemble des parties prenantes.
-Selon la composition de l'équipe, tu pourras être responsable de faire monter en compétence les Products Managers, en créant un environnement propice à leur réussite, leur montée en compétences et leur projection chez le client et/ou chez Theodo.
- Garantir la satisfaction client sur le long terme, en construisant une relation de confiance, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités et en collaborant avec les équipes Sales, Staffing et People.
 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
- TF1+ : a été conçu et déployé en 6 mois pour positionner TF1 comme leader du streaming gratuit avec publicité, avec un lancement simultané sur 13 plateformes (web, mobile, TV connectées, box). Malgré de fortes contraintes techniques propres aux environnements TV et la coordination de près de 200 collaborateurs, 40 experts Theodo ont livré une plateforme stable, performante et prête à absorber une audience massive dès le premier jour. Résultat : +40 % de chiffre d’affaires.
 
- Compagnie des Alpes : premier exploitant de domaines skiables en France, a confié à Theodo la refonte des applications mobiles de ses stations pour offrir une expérience digitale unifiée tout en respectant l’identité des stations. Nous avons conçu une application en marque blanche reposant sur un Design System commun, déployée dans 6 domaines. Pensée à partir du terrain, l’app maximise le temps passé sur les pistes grâce à des parcours optimisés (notamment un tunnel d’achat one-step mobile-first et le forfait dématérialisé) devenus des leviers clés de conversion et de fluidité en station.
 
Tes perspectives d'évolution :
Les voies qui s’ouvrent à toi ensuite :
- devenir Group PM et manager les Lead PM d'un grand compte
- t’orienter vers un rôle plus commercial sur d’autres grands comptes : Key Account Manager
- mettre ton expertise de gestion de projets complexes à profit dans un rôle de COO ou CPO
 
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
 
Profil recherché :
- Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, avec plus de 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle, dont au moins 4 ans en product management (Senior PM / Lead PM / Head of Product), en startup, ESN ou cabinet de conseil.
- Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet.
- Excellente aisance relationnelle et client : capable de créer une relation de confiance, d’échanger avec des interlocuteurs de top management, et à l’aise dans des contextes grands comptes.
- Posture client first : disponible, réactif·ve, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours, d’anticiper les besoins et de gérer des situations sensibles.
- Solides compétences en négociation et management : écoute active, questionnement, capacité à challenger, à gérer le conflit et à délivrer des feedbacks exigeants avec calme et clarté, dans une logique de progression collective.
- Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ?
L’environnement:
💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités
🤝  Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires.
🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…)
🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel
 
Le package :
📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe
💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor
🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…)
🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...)
🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an
🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50%
🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile

About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As our Launch Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end delivery of our partner onboarding, from kick-off through go-live and post-launch activities, turning complex, regulated brokerage integrations into predictable, high-quality launches.

Our partner universe is evolving: alongside our direct business with fintechs and neobanks, we’re building a combined offering with dwpbank, bringing a new wave of partners and increased cross-organization complexity. We’re therefore building a dedicated Launch Manager function to run these onboardings with clear ownership.

In this setup, you’ll provide the coordination we’re building, driving the launch plan, steering stakeholders, and ensuring a clean handover to Partner Management once the partner is live. You’ll sit at the center of cross-functional execution, aligning Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions (and, where relevant, dwpbank) to keep delivery on time, within scope, and operationally sound.

In this role you will:

  • Lead end-to-end partner launches by owning the onboarding plan, milestones, and delivery rhythm across Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions — so partners go live faster and with fewer surprises.

  • Drive alignment and decision-making between partnership leads, product counterparts, and executive sponsors — so scope, priorities, and trade-offs are clear and execution stays on track.
