Head of Product - Cards - Amsterdam

Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

Cards is one of the most strategically important products at Mollie. It is the primary payment method operating at a global scale and the central enabler for Mollie to serve larger, more sophisticated merchants. As the accountable lead for online cards acceptance, you will own one of the highest net revenue-generating areas in the business, and your work will directly shape Mollie's ability to compete for and retain enterprise and mid-market merchants.

As the Head of Product for Cards Acquiring, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for one of the most critical payment methods. You will bridge the gap between heavy technical infrastructure and high-impact commercial enablement. Leading a cross-functional team of around 20 people that includes product delivery managers, a product partnership person, a dedicated data person, and a PMM, you will scale Mollie’s cards capabilities beyond Europe, unlock new merchant categories, and ensure our proposition wins the hearts of highly sophisticated merchants. You will also work directly with payment schemes and external partners, making decisions that influence both the product roadmap and Mollie's broader positioning in the market.

The cards domain is expected to become an increasingly primary driver of Mollie's growth over time, with the potential for the online and in-person card acceptance platforms to converge and expand the scope of this role significantly. If you want to own something that matters at a company that is moving fast in the right direction, this is it.

What you'll ship

  • End-to-end product ownership: own the full cards acceptance product lifecycle—from deep technical infrastructure and processing stability to commercial enablement.

  • Go-To-Market & commercial enablement: lead the GTM strategy for new card features in tight lockstep with Product Marketing (PMM) and Commercial teams. You'll translate complex technical capabilities into crystal-clear value propositions that our sales teams can run with.

  • Global scale: drive the geographic expansion of our cards product, building out capabilities beyond Europe to support Mollie’s international growth.

  • Portfolio optimisation: Identify untapped merchant vertical opportunities and make data-driven decisions to maximise net revenue across the entire cards portfolio.

  • Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing product team.

What You’ll Bring

  • Commercial & GTM Strategy: A proven track record of launching successful financial/payment products. You know how to price, position, and package features alongside PMM to win market share.

  • Partnership acumen: deep understanding of direct vs. indirect relationship strategies in the payments ecosystem and their respective commercial implications.

  • Technical depth: you aren't afraid of complexity. You can comfortably navigate the underlying technical architecture of cards acquiring, including the intricacies of the PCI compliance landscape.

  • Operational scale: experience managing operations-heavy environments and a proven ability to build scalable organisational structures that handle massive transaction volumes.

  • Customer obsession: this is non-negotiable at Mollie. You have a relentless drive to understand merchant pain points and build products that genuinely delight them.

  • Leadership: experience leading and developing cross-functional teams. You know how to cultivate a culture of high performance, accountability, and psychological safety.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

Sturing en beheersing

Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

  • Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

  • Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

  • Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

  • Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

  • Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

  • Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

  • Help mature our design system in Figma.


You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products.

  • You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

  • You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

  • Strong Figma skills.

  • Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

  • A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

Strong candidates may also

  • Have worked on AI products.

  • Have experience in healthcare, or another regulated environment such as legaltech, regtech or govtech.

  • Have worked on a CE-certified or medical device product, and know what that means for usability testing.

  • Have experience running usability studies or user interviews.

  • Enjoy working with a team for the long run and growing together with a scale-up.

What we offer

  • Salary between €4,000 and €4,500 per month, plus holiday allowance.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive

About P1 Security

Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security, OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing.

Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America.

The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/).

We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on.

Job Description

If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together.

What you will do

  • Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment.

  • PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned.

  • CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws.

  • Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers.

  • Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines.

  • Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base.

  • Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting.

  • The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial)

  • MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure

  • Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment.

  • Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications.

  • Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure.

  • Relevant certifications, such as:

  • OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED

  • GPEN / GXPN / GRID

  • CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO

  • Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings)

  • Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices.

jobs.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Join us as a Technical Program Manager in our new Project Management Office (PMO), reporting to the PMO Lead. You will own day-to-day program management for one to two development programs, keeping schedules, responsibilities and risks visible across development and production departments. Working in a highly technical, fast-moving environment, you will build the habits and practice of program discipline that the whole company will adopt as the PMO scales.

What you'll be doing

  • Ownership and responsibility

    • Own top level execution and delivery of assigned programs.

    • Partner with project and discipline leads on cross-department programs to ensure execution on schedule and within budget.

    • Manage the day-to-day execution of the assigned programs including handoffs across departments.

    • Lead the program-management activities for your assigned programs: schedule build, baselining, gate reviews, etc.

  • Manage uncertainty and risk

    • Identify risks and bottlenecks early

    • Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

    • Escalate risks and blockers to the relevant stakeholders promptly.

  • Support growth and development of the team

    • Mentor junior program managers in program execution and collaborative leadership.

    • Support the PMO Lead in rolling out common language, product lifecycle, team rhythms for programs.

    • Support general program management training across the organization.

Your Profile

  • Leadership experience

    • Over 6 years of experience, including more than 4 years managing the delivery of complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a program management role.

    • Lead programs coordinating across functions and departments.

    • Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.

    • Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

  • Approach

    • Learn quickly in a highly technical, low-maturity field, without needing a deep technical background in quantum computing on day one.

    • Translate a long-term strategy into an execution plan for your program teams.

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.

    • Bring together world-class technical experts and project leads to execute on highly complex programs.

  • Technical Background

    • MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field.

  • Communication

    • Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating program management ideas to highly technical people.

    • Collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues across the organization - Product, Research and Development, Operations, Management team, etc.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. 
 
C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille. 

Tes futures missions :
En tant que Lead Product Manager, tu pilotes des projets produits complexes en portant la vision produit, en orchestrant le delivery et en garantissant la création de valeur pour le client comme pour les équipes.
 
- Définir et porter la stratégie produit avec le client : modélisation de la valeur, architecture produit, EPICs, arbitrage des trade-offs et alignement technico-fonctionnel.
- Assurer un delivery réussi en coordonnant plusieurs squads pour livrer des projets complexes dans les temps, le budget et le niveau de qualité attendu.
- Créer les conditions de réussite des équipes en définissant le bon set-up (équipes Theodo ou partenaires), en négociant les moyens nécessaires et en adaptant l’organisation aux contraintes du projet.
- Apporter de la visibilité et de la clarté via des dispositifs de gouvernance adaptés, pour aligner l’ensemble des parties prenantes.
-Selon la composition de l'équipe, tu pourras être responsable de faire monter en compétence les Products Managers, en créant un environnement propice à leur réussite, leur montée en compétences et leur projection chez le client et/ou chez Theodo.
- Garantir la satisfaction client sur le long terme, en construisant une relation de confiance, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités et en collaborant avec les équipes Sales, Staffing et People.
 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
- iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning.
 
- Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité.
 
Tes perspectives d'évolution :
Les voies qui s’ouvrent à toi ensuite :
- devenir Group PM et manager les Lead PM d'un grand compte
- t’orienter vers un rôle plus commercial sur d’autres grands comptes : Key Account Manager
- mettre ton expertise de gestion de projets complexes à profit dans un rôle de COO ou CPO
 
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
 
Profil recherché :
- Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, avec plus de 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle, dont au moins 4 ans en product management (Senior PM / Lead PM / Head of Product), en startup, ESN ou cabinet de conseil.
- Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet.
- Excellente aisance relationnelle et client : capable de créer une relation de confiance, d’échanger avec des interlocuteurs de top management, et à l’aise dans des contextes grands comptes.
- Posture client first : disponible, réactif·ve, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours, d’anticiper les besoins et de gérer des situations sensibles.
- Solides compétences en négociation et management : écoute active, questionnement, capacité à challenger, à gérer le conflit et à délivrer des feedbacks exigeants avec calme et clarté, dans une logique de progression collective.
- Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.

L’environnement:

jobs.title: Social & Follower - Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.

 

Your expedition: Product & Growth

 

This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.

 

While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers.

 

The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

  • Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

  • Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

  • Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

  • Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role

✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know.

✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth

✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world)

✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back

✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo

✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 70.000 - 80.000 (medior level) and EUR 85.000 - 95.000 (senior level) gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)
jobs.description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here.

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €105k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

Role Details

Level: Senior/ Lead

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 months

Day Rate: Dependent on experience

Weekly hours: 3-4 days/ week

Location: Remote Europe, GMT/BST or CET friendly

Language: English, plus Spanish and/or Portuguese

 

In this role, you’ll be a senior technical advisor to city governments across North, Central and South America, working in both an advisory and a hands-on capacity to help them design, build and launch small scale pilots of new services for residents.

Working alongside experienced product managers, data scientists, AI engineers, and designers, you’ll help multidisciplinary city teams build in-house product development capability by prototyping and delivering digital products and services, many of which harness data and AI.

You won’t own the decisions, but you’ll shape them. You’ll guide cities through the full product development lifecycle, helping them weigh the strategic and technical trade-offs at each stage: how to design system and data architecture that’s right-sized for a pilot but built to scale, how to prototype and test possible solutions to validate assumptions, and when AI approaches such as machine learning or large language models are the right tool (and when they aren’t). You’ll roll up your sleeves to prototype and demonstrate what good looks like, while making sure your clients understand the reasoning well enough to own the outcome.

This role suits someone with the technical depth of a tech lead, and the judgement, communication skills and patience to lead through influence rather than authority. You’ll need to work fluently in English and in at least one of Spanish or Portuguese.

 

Key skills and experiences

  • Extensive hands-on technical experience, with strong knowledge of system and data architecture, data pipelines, DevOps and infrastructure, and a track record of delivering and deploying robust solutions end to end, from prototype to pilot, across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments, including legacy systems and resource-constrained ones, so that your recommendations are realistic and buildable.

  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning approaches, including large language models, and experience deploying them or working alongside ML engineers to integrate them into products, with enough understanding to judge when they’re the right tool and how to build them in responsibly.

  • Experience taking products from early concept to first release, while laying foundations for scale, with a track record of rapid prototyping and assumption testing and a “show, don’t tell” approach that uses working prototypes to build shared understanding and inform decisions.

  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams, collaborating closely with product managers, designers and other disciplines throughout the product lifecycle.

  • The ability to explain technical ideas and trade-offs clearly to audiences of all technical levels, from engineers to non-technical stakeholders and senior decision-makers.

  • Experience setting technical direction for a project or small team and guiding other engineers, as a tech lead or senior engineer.

  • Experience influencing technical decisions you don't directly control, whether in a consulting or advisory role or as an in-house engineer working across teams and with senior stakeholders.

  • Curiosity and flexibility in problem solving, and comfort working through ambiguity and uncertainty in complex environments.

  • Professional working proficiency in English and in Spanish and/or Portuguese.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with multicultural teams and on international projects.

  • Experience working with government or other public-sector organisations, or on services for residents and citizens.

  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, such as data privacy, bias and fairness, transparency, and the governance considerations specific to public-sector use of AI.

  • Experience supporting organisations to build their own technical capability, for example through coaching, mentoring or setting up new teams and practices.

Our hiring process

We’ve kept the process short and focused. Here’s what to expect:

1. Application & Video
As part of your application, we’ll ask you to record a short video (1–3 minutes, instructions below) describing a technical project — work or personal — that you really enjoyed working on.

  • Please record it in Spanish or Portuguese, whichever you speak fluently.

  • You don’t need to show your face — a voiceover on a screen share, or any other format you’re comfortable with, is fine.

  • We want to understand what the project was and why you enjoyed working on it. This isn’t a test of production quality; we’re interested in how you think and talk about your work.

2. Initial screening call
A short conversation to cover the basics — your timezone, working languages, availability, and a chance for you to ask early questions about the role and how we work.

3. Technical interview (~60 minutes)
A deeper conversation about your technical background and experience. We’ll talk through how you’ve approached real problems, the decisions you’ve made, and how you’d apply that thinking to the work at IF.

4. Ways of working interview (~45–60 minutes)
A conversation about how you collaborate, communicate, and work with others — including how you operate in an advisory capacity with clients and teams.

We’ll aim to keep you updated at every stage and let you know the outcome promptly after each step.


How to record and submit your video

The simplest way is Loom (free, no download needed):

  1. Go to loom.com and create a free account.

  2. Click New video → Record a video in your browser. Choose Screen and camera or Screen only if you’d prefer not to appear on camera, and make sure your microphone is selected.

  3. Record your video — remember, 1 to 3 minutes is all we need. The free plan has a 5-minute limit, which is plenty.

  4. When you stop recording, Loom will open the video and give you a link. Click Copy link.

  5. Check the sharing setting is Anyone with the link can view.

  6. Paste the link into the Link to your video field on the application form.

Present clear recommendations on market opportunities, regulatory strategy, investment requirements, and launch readiness.

  • Build external relationships: Partner with local regulators, financial institutions, payment networks, advisers, and other strategic stakeholders to support regulatory approvals, establish local capabilities, and unlock new market opportunities.

  • Build a scalable expansion engine: Develop repeatable frameworks, tools, and operating processes that enable Airwallex to expand faster and more efficiently. Leverage AI and automation to improve regulatory intelligence, market analysis, execution tracking, and cross-functional coordination.

jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We are hiring a backend-leaning Tech Lead to lead a team of 3-4 engineers and own the tech for a part of Superchat’s product.

This is a hands-on leadership role: You’ll spend roughly half your time designing and building software and the other half enabling your team to perform at its best. Work directly on architecture, development and important projects while creating the clarity, feedback and environment your engineers need to deliver an excellent product

Who We Want

A strong, current backend engineer.
You bring 3+ years of experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer and remain deeply involved in software development. You are comfortable owning, designing and building crucial parts of production systems.

Experienced with the JVM ecosystem.
You have substantial experience with Java or another JVM language. Kotlin and AWS experience are a plus, since our backend runs on Kotlin/Quarkus.

Ready to lead people.
You may already have worked in a hybrid Tech Lead role, have been an Engineering manager for a short time or be taking your first steps in people leadership after successfully owning projects and architecture. What matters is that you genuiely want to help people grow

Strong at delivery.
You know how to turn product goals into reality. You are used to work in fast-paced startups and are a driver to increase velocity.

Product-minded.
You care about solving the customers problem. You engage with product decisions, challenge assumptions constructivly and find pragmatic solutions to build things in a lean way.

Clear communicator.
You are able to explain complex technical things in details to Engineers and in an understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. You create alignment and motivate people

Excited about AI-assisted development.
You are already using AI in your development workflow and are eager to explore how it can improve engineering speed, quality and the way teams work.

Who We Don’t Want

Pure people manager. You no longer want to work directly on software. This role requires meaningful, ongoing involvement in architecture, implementation, code review, and technical problem-solving.

Hero engineer. You want to make every important technical decision yourself or become the bottleneck for the team. Your job is to raise the effectiveness of the whole team, not to be the only person who can solve difficult problems.

Pure delivery manager. You treat engineering as a ticketing operation focused only on timelines and task tracking instead of product quality, technical health, and team growth. We need engineering leaders, not project coordinators.

Remote-only operator. You prefer fully remote work and don’t want to actively build relationships and culture in person with the team. We believe strong engineering leadership requires regular in-person collaboration and presence in Berlin.

Your Day To Day

  • Spend approximately 50% of your time contributing directly to architecture, development, code reviews, and important technical projects.
  • Lead a team of 3-4 engineers and take responsibility for its effectiveness, technical quality, and delivery.
  • Work closely with your Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape solutions, scope projects, and set priorities.
  • Establish clear technical direction while enabling engineers to own decisions and develop their judgment.
  • Run regular 1:1s, give actionable feedback, and support each engineer’s development and performance.
  • Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and help the team identify delivery risks early.
  • Improve engineering practices and explore effective uses of AI throughout the software-development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to hiring through technical interviews, structured feedback, and candidate conversations.

Stakeholders

Director of Engineering: Your manager and partner on people development, calibration, processes.
Direct Reports: Engineers in your team; you own their development, performance and growth
Product Manager: PMs own what and why; you own how (delivery) and who (people)
CTO and CPO: We are a lean organization with a flat hierarchy. You will regulary disccuss the direction of architecture with the CTO and product with the CPO

Why People Choose Us

Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics

Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable

Modern stack. Kotlin/Quarkus, AWS, TypeScript/React/Next.js, and LangGraph for AI-powered features

Squad-based organization. Each squad owns its domain end-to-end with real ownership and autonomy

Two clear career tracks. We support both individual contributor growth (up to Staff level) and Management Paths with explicit reversibility between both and Tech Lead being the first level of management that is still quite hands-on

Product-led structure. PMs report directly to the CPO, keeping product strategy focused, consistent, and clearly prioritized

Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup

Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
  • Regular company and team events
  • Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth
  • Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment

We want to build a community, not just a company.

It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.

Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech.
Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein.
 
Pionniers de la conteneurisation, nous plaçons aujourd'hui l'innovation au cœur de notre approche Cloud.
 
Nous concevons des offres qui adressent les enjeux les plus actuels du secteur :
  • Accélérer les migrations et modernisations Cloud grâce à l'IA pour créer de la valeur au plus vite.
  • Construire et infogérer des environnements d'industries régulées (ex : HDS pour la santé, SecNumCloud) sans sacrifier le time to market.
  • ⁠Exploiter tout le potentiel des LLMs tout en optimisant la performance cloud, les coûts et la sûreté industrielle.

Ton équipe :
Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client, réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. En tant qu’Engineering Manager, ton rôle est de manager jusqu’à 4 tech leads, soit de chapeauter la réussite de 4 projets, en binôme avec un(e) Group Project Manager.

Le besoin actuel porte sur des missions “grands-comptes” avec des produits et architectures complexes, développées par plusieurs squads de Theodo :

- Contribuer au développement business : tu participes aux discussions stratégiques avec nos clients (DSI, sponsors…), tu aides à identifier des opportunités et tu es acteur de l’avant-vente avec nos sales.
 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
- iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité.

Perspectives d’évolution moyen terme (1 - 2 ans) :

jobs.description:
Panteia | Transport & Mobility | EU Policy & Research


About Panteia

Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. Headquartered in Zoetermeer, Panteia employs around 70 professionals and works for national governments, the European Commission, EU agencies  (CoR, CINEA), international institutions (e.g. EIB, World Bank, etc) and branch organisations.  Panteia is part of the PanMuc group, together with Revnext (digitalisation, cybersecurity, technology and innovation). Together, they form a growing European consultancy ecosystem operating at the intersection of transport, sustainability, economics and policy. Panteia also collaborates closely with partner consultancies across all 27 EU Member States.

Within the Transport & Mobility (T&M) unit, Panteia has built a strong and trusted position in EU projects, including policy studies, corridor studies, market studies, evaluations and impact assessments.

 

As Panteia’s EU transport and mobility portfolio continues to grow in scale and complexity, this role is created to anchor delivery quality and long-term excellence.

 

The role

To further strengthen delivery quality and execution excellence, Panteia is looking for a Principal Consultant EU – Project Delivery & Excellence.

This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional  standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy.

The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners.

 

Key responsibilities

Project delivery & leadership

  • Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research.

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in line with contractual and quality requirements.

  • Act as senior escalation point for delivery issues, client questions and consortium coordination.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with the European Commission, EU agencies and international partners.

 

Team & quality leadership

  • Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners).

  • Safeguard consistency, methodological soundness and professional quality across deliverables.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes.

 

Role in acquisition & transition

The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals:

  • Shaping delivery concepts, work plans and governance structures in EU proposals.

  • Identifying delivery risks and mitigation strategies at proposal stage.

  • Ensuring a smooth and effective handover from acquisition to project execution.

 

Position in the organisation

  • Reports to: Team manager.

  • Team: Works closely with an international EU team of approx. 10–15 consultants, plus external consortium partners.

  • Leadership role: Senior delivery lead across multiple EU-funded projects, with high autonomy and responsibility.

 

Practicalities

  • Location: Zoetermeer (NL), hybrid model
    – Regular presence at HQ expected (approx. 3 days/week)
    – Occasional travel to Brussels and other EU locations.

  • Languages: English required; additional EU languages are an asset.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Package: Competitive salary, aligned with Dutch consultancy benchmarks.

 

Why join Panteia?

  • Work at the forefront of EU transport and mobility policy – from social aspects of transport, to transport infrastructure resilience.

  • Combine analytical depth with real policy impact.

  • Focus on delivery excellence rather than sales targets.

  • Work in a compact, expert-driven team.

  • Enjoy autonomy to shape how EU projects are delivered.

  • Join a respected, collaborative team with strong EU credentials.

  • Be part of a growing European consultancy ecosystem within PanMuc.


What Panteia is looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience managing EU-funded projects in transport, sustainability or policy consulting.

  • Proven track record in complex project execution within a multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Experience with policy studies, corridor studies, impact evaluations, stakeholder consultation, and socio-economic analysis.

  • Excellent team leadership and co-ordination skills.

  • Familiarity with DG MOVE, DG CLIMA or similar EU institutions and processes.

  • Strong communicator in English (spoken and written). Dutch or any additional EU language is a plus.

  • MSc or PhD in Transport Economics, Civil Engineering, Spatial Planning, Public Policy or related field.

  • Willingness to travel to Brussels and other EU locations when needed.

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

Even better…

  • SQL experience.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and marketing automation tools.

  • Previous 0-1 startup or operational experience.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. ⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range.

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐

You may be a great fit at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data‑driven and analytical: you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

  • Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR or Finance

.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.description:
About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

Ben jij een Software Engineer die graag zelfstandig bouwt aan slimme, schaalbare software? Wil je technische uitdagingen oplossen, meedenken over nieuwe functionaliteiten en jezelf blijven ontwikkelen binnen een ervaren productteam? Dan is deze functie bij BAS World iets voor jou!

Bij BAS World ontwikkelen we digitale producten waarmee klanten wereldwijd trucks, trailers, machines en onderdelen kunnen kopen en verkopen. Onze software ondersteunt internationale handelsprocessen en wordt dagelijks gebruikt door klanten en collega's over de hele wereld.

Als Medior Software Engineer werk je binnen een van onze productteams aan betrouwbare en schaalbare software. Je pakt zelfstandig technische vraagstukken op, denkt mee over de beste oplossingen en bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van het begrijpen van het probleem tot het bouwen, testen en onderhouden van de oplossing.

Je werkt nauw samen met andere Engineers, Product Owners en collega's vanuit de business. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om technische keuzes te maken, nieuwe ideeën aan te dragen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior Software Engineer werk je aan digitale producten die direct bijdragen aan de groei van BAS World. Je schrijft niet alleen code, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we onze software en processen kunnen verbeteren.

Je werkt binnen een van onze vijf productpijlers: Operations, Parts & Tyres, Buyer, Seller of Platform Engineering. Samen met jouw team ontwikkel je oplossingen die waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten en collega's.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt schaalbare en betrouwbare software;

  • Je pakt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische vraagstukken op, van analyse tot implementatie en beheer;

  • Je werkt samen met Product Owners, Engineers en collega's vanuit de business om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar technische oplossingen;

  • Je denkt mee tijdens de discoveryfase, onderzoekt verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en test ideeën waar nodig met prototypes;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code en draagt bij aan de kwaliteit, beveiliging en betrouwbaarheid van onze software;

  • Je voert code reviews uit, werkt samen via pair programming en deelt actief kennis met collega's;

  • Je onderzoekt en verhelpt incidenten en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen;

  • Je signaleert technische verbeterkansen en experimenteert met nieuwe technologieën en moderne engineeringtools.

Je krijgt de vrijheid om zelfstandig aan oplossingen te werken, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. Je leert van ervaren collega's, deelt jouw eigen kennis en werkt samen aan producten die dagelijks wereldwijd worden gebruikt.

Wat maakt deze functie zo interessant?

Bij BAS World werk je niet alleen aan technische oplossingen, maar denk je ook mee over de ontwikkeling van onze digitale producten. Je krijgt de ruimte om kritische vragen te stellen, ideeën te testen en invloed uit te oefenen op technische keuzes.

Je werkt in een productgedreven organisatie waar we continu zoeken naar manieren om onze software slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken.

Of je nu nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwikkelt, bestaande systemen verbetert of experimenteert met AI en cloud-native technologie: je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf technisch verder te ontwikkelen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris dat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen een ervaren productteam;

  • De mogelijkheid om te werken aan digitale producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt;

  • Volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen via interne en externe opleidingen;

  • De vrijheid om te experimenteren met AI, cloud-native technologie en moderne engineeringtools;

  • Directe samenwerking met ervaren Engineers, Product Owners en andere technische specialisten;

  • De keuze tussen een MacBook of Windows-laptop;

  • Een informele, internationale werkomgeving met korte lijnen en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.


Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een Software Engineer die zelfstandig kan werken, graag technische uitdagingen aangaat en verder kijkt dan alleen het schrijven van code.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt ervaring als Software Engineer en kunt zelfstandig nieuwe functionaliteiten en technische oplossingen ontwikkelen;

  • Je schrijft leesbare, testbare en onderhoudbare code;

  • Je denkt mee over technische keuzes en weet jouw ideeën en oplossingen duidelijk uit te leggen;
